content.text: If Stripe isn't available in your country, a PayPal account suspension can hold your funds for up to 180 days – a crippling blow for digital sellers. In Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and many other countries, Gumroad's and Payhip's global reach is illusory, and their limitations can be just as devastating. You need a reliable, sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto|infrastructure]] that owns your digital products, not a third-party platform that can suspend or restrict your access.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Gumroad payhip

Gumroad is a digital storefront that allows creators to sell their work directly to customers, but its limitations in restricted countries are well-documented. Payhip is another popular platform, but its PayPal integration can be a liability for sellers in countries where PayPal is restricted or suspended. NOW[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-working-today|Get Payment]]s, on the other hand, offers 300+ cryptocurrencies, no KYC, no buyer account required, and automatic webhook fires the moment payment confirms on-chain, making it an attractive alternative for digital sellers in restricted countries.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad and Payhip have limitations in countries where Stripe, PayPal, or other payment gateways are restricted or unavailable. In these scenarios, digital sellers are left with few options, and their businesses suffer as a result. NOWPayments, however, offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that allows digital sellers to accept payments directly from their customers, without relying on third-party platforms or payment gateways.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-what-nobody-tells-5|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]] never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
NOWPayments offers a sovereign commerce infrastructure that owns your digital products, not a third-party platform that can suspend or restrict your access.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
